about.title: Japan in one place in Považská Bystrica
paragraphs: Japan Day of Tea and Culture returns to Považská Bystrica for the third time in 2026. The event brings together Japanese gastronomy, tea, traditional arts, samurai culture, martial arts, talks and exhibitions.

The event will take place on 7 November at the House of Culture in Považská Bystrica. We will use the main hall as well as the puppet theatre, creating space for performances, presentations, Japanese products and tastings.
Throughout the day you can meet people who have dedicated themselves to Japan for many years, taste authentic food and teas, and experience Japanese culture up close.
